testCase.name: [dev] S08 Tracker status × screen: the Meds toggle shows every tracker row with the same status, date and reason as the tracker

descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-17 Post-Round Review & Completion · S08 「tracker 状态 × 界面：Meds 切换显示 tracker 的每一行，状态、日期和原因都和 tracker 一样」 Tracker status × screen: the Meds toggle shows every tracker row with the same status, date and reason as the tracker

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U7 The Meds toggle shows the same Medication Tracker (same data) as the Encounter tab.（UAT TC-17；TFA-92595 AC 5；TFA-92595 How it works 5） — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress
  • U1 The Note / Tasks / Meds toggle shows only one section at a time, and each section shows its own correct content (the three views hold correct, independent data).（UAT TC-17；TFA-92595 AC 2；TFA-92595 How it works 1） — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress

测试设计方法：决策表（decision-table） — 几个条件的组合列成表，每个组合各验一次，看结果是不是按规则变。

Given A Hospital patient in note-ready whose tracker has one row per status, each status with its own date, plus an active row last mentioned 20 h ago; a second Hospital patient and the Nursing Home resident each with one decoy medication

When Look at the Pre-Round Medications panel (the tracker on main), the Encounter tab, and the Post-Round meds toggle

Then For each row the Post-Round meds toggle shows what the tracker shows, in the same row: active → listed with no tag; held → 'Held · Oct 12' + 'AKI'; changed → 'Changed · Oct 10' + 'was 40 mg'; discontinued → 'Stopped · Oct 9'; single-dose → 'Given · Oct 8'; no row missing, none added (no decoy from another patient or context), no note or task text

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：oracle.mjs: cp1 and cp3 mustContain all six names, the four tag+date strings and both reasons; cp3 mustNotContain note text, the resident or either decoy. Each status has its own date, so a tag/date swap between rows is caught page-wide; …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S08 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-17.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：AGENT · 浏览器 agent — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
